Jason — thanks for the clear ask. We're glad to expand the Dedicated pool. Key points up front:
- Pricing: I'll attach the updated SOW with line item for +40 GPUs and the 12mo term with throughput SLA addendum. Ballpark delta: ~22% increase on committed monthly spend (we'll finalize in SOW).
- Cutover: Redwood ops prefers a weekend window; we provision and stage the new pool ahead of traffic shift, perform a 2-hour canary, then shift split traffic 10/30/60/100 over 3 hours. Full rollback available at every step.
- Uplift credits: Redwood can offer a one-time operational credit tied to missed SLA on first 30 days post-cutover.

I'll loop in Connor and Marissa to capture the cutover checklist and CS acceptance criteria; Karthik will own commercial terms and SOW finalization. Sending the draft checklist and canary plan now.

Subject: RE: Renewal discussion + request for additional reserved GPUs

Team — draft operational plan below (high level). I've attached a more detailed cutover playbook. Please review and flag timing conflicts.

Cutover summary (proposal):
- Provisioning window (stage): Oct 14 00:00 - Oct 15 12:00 (new reserved pool configured in us-west-2).
- Dry-run validation (internal): Oct 15 13:00 - 16:00 (model warmup, perf benchmarks, KV cache priming).
- Customer canary: Oct 16 02:00 - 04:00 (10% traffic to new pool).
- Progressive ramp: Oct 16 05:00 - 08:00 (30% -> 60% -> 100% over 3 steps each ~60min).
- Post-cutover validation: Oct 16 09:00 - 12:00 (latency/throughput checks; rollback if >10% degradation vs baseline).

Rollback plan: immediate rollback to prior pool with DNS/route flip; estimated RTO 12-20 minutes for a failover if the canary shows regressions.

Acceptance criteria (CS owns):
- P95 latency within 12% of baseline load-tested numbers during canary.
- No client-request errors increased by >0.5% sustained over 15 minutes.
- KV cache hit rate within 5% of pre-cutover.

Actions:
- Marissa: finalize customer-facing acceptance checklist and test payloads.
- Karthik: confirm commercial language for SLA addendum and the operational credit clause.
- Neha: get formal sign-off from Jason/Priya on Oct 06.

Connor O'Brien
Site Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
